name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The redundant Existence clauses R2, R4, and R6 (Existence(has_matching_key), Existence(target_door_open), Existence(target_room_entered)) only repeat what the hard Precedence chain plus the final Existence(target_picked_up) already force; the task's chain is a stated order, so each earlier step needs no Existence of its own. Keep Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key), Precedence(has_matching_key, target_door_open), Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered), Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up); drop the three redundant Existence clauses.

texts: Find the key before picking it up.
Open the locked door only after picking up the matching key.
Enter the target room only after opening the locked door.
Pick up the ball only after entering the target room.
